Multiset partition enumeration

Source: R/utilities-enumerative.R
multiset_enumeration.Rd

Knuth's Algorithm M as SymPy's MultisetPartitionTraverser: enum_all(mult) lists every partition of the multiset with component multiplicities mult, enum_small(mult, ub) those with fewer than ub parts, enum_large(mult, lb) those with more than lb parts and enum_range(mult, lb, ub) those in between; count_partitions(mult) counts them. Each partition is a list of parts, each part a vector of component indices (from 0), or of components when given. multiset_partitions_taocp(mult) is enum_all().

Usage

enum_all(mult, components = NULL)

enum_small(mult, ub, components = NULL)

enum_large(mult, lb, components = NULL)

enum_range(mult, lb, ub, components = NULL)

multiset_partitions_taocp(mult, components = NULL)

count_partitions(mult)

Arguments

mult

Multiplicities of the components.

components

Labels of the components.

lb, ub

Bounds on the number of parts.

Value

A list of partitions, or a count.

Examples

enum_all(c(2, 2))
#> [[1]]
#> [[1]][[1]]
#> [1] 0 0 1 1
#> 
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [[2]][[1]]
#> [1] 0 0 1
#> 
#> [[2]][[2]]
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> [[3]][[1]]
#> [1] 0 0
#> 
#> [[3]][[2]]
#> [1] 1 1
#> 
#> 
#> [[4]]
#> [[4]][[1]]
#> [1] 0 0
#> 
#> [[4]][[2]]
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> [[4]][[3]]
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> 
#> [[5]]
#> [[5]][[1]]
#> [1] 0 1 1
#> 
#> [[5]][[2]]
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> 
#> [[6]]
#> [[6]][[1]]
#> [1] 0 1
#> 
#> [[6]][[2]]
#> [1] 0 1
#>

#> [[7]]
#> [[7]][[1]]
#> [1] 0 1
#> 
#> [[7]][[2]]
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> [[7]][[3]]
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> 
#> [[8]]
